递推过程的 NVFP4 scale 选择算法，并给出面向 70B 到 397B 级别模型的分布式重构框架。信息增益在于：它把量化格式约束、二阶重构目标和系统内存约束放在同一个求解流程里，而不是只改 codebook 或只做离线 scale search。","technical_approach":"算法部分叫 Schur Replay。GPTQ 的目标来自校准激活的 Hessian H=XX^T，每个输出 row 的目标独立，但共享同一个输入 Hessian。GPTQ 按列量化，使用二阶信息对后续未量化列做误差补偿，因此状态是递推变化的。Schur Replay 对每个硬件可导出的 NVFP4 block scale 都执行一次候选相关的 GPTQ replay：不只看当前 16 个值的静态舍入误差，而是模拟该 scale 会触发的列更新，再用 conditional Schur objective 评分，评分时还考虑后续未量化列仍能提供的补偿能力。这样 scale 的选择更接近最终重构误差。系统部分利用一个结构事实：不同输出 rows 的 GPTQ recurrence 相互独立。框架把同一层的输出 rows 分给多个 tensor-parallel ranks，而不是让一个大层串行求解；同时采用 active-layer residency，只让当前层权重驻留在设备上；校准激活在 device、host、disk 间分层管理；完成 NVFP4 导出后释放 BF16 层。","experiments":"实验报告了两个层面的结果。质量方面，Schur Replay 与分布式重构框架在 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 和 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 上测试，覆盖 7 个 benchmark，恢复到 GPTQ is sequential: quantizing one input column changes the compensated state of later columns. NVFP4, however, assigns one E4M3 block scale to every 16 E2M1 weights. If a scale is scored only on the initial block values, the score can disagree with the final reconstruction error produced after GPTQ compensation. The second problem is scalability: for 70B–400B-class models, full-precision weights, calibration activations, and second-order state cannot all reside on accelerators at once.","importance":"The contribution is mainly in low-bit inference, but it matters for foundation-model evaluation and release pipelines. Many large checkpoints are evaluated or served in 4-bit-like formats, and poor reconstruction can distort model comparisons. The work is useful because it treats the quantization format, GPTQ’s second-order recurrence, and large-model memory constraints as one coupled problem. It is not a pretraining recipe, but it helps reduce deployment-side artifacts when studying very large models.","technical_approach":"The algorithm, Schur Replay, is a recurrence-aware scale-selection method for NVFP4. GPTQ uses a calibration Hessian H=XX^T and quantizes columns sequentially, compensating future columns after each rounding decision. Since output rows are independent under the same input Hessian, each row follows its own recurrence. For each hardware-valid block scale, Schur Replay replays the GPTQ updates that this candidate scale would induce, then scores the block with a conditional Schur objective that accounts for the remaining compensation available from unquantized columns. This differs from static block-scale search, which evaluates scales before the candidate has changed the GPTQ state. The systems design exploits row independence: rows of the same weight matrix are split across tensor-parallel ranks, only the active layer is kept on device, calibration activations are tiered across device, host, and disk, and full-precision layers are retired after recoverable NVFP4 export.","experiments":"The reported quality results cover Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct across seven benchmarks, with 99.35% / 100.84% recovery relative to BF16. On the 397B model, the infrastructure reports measured per-layer compute speedups of 15.17× / 23.14× over ModelOpt / LLM Compressor at about 35.0GB peak memory per GPU. The important idea is product-aware quantization: the transform is designed using both the cached tensor and the computation that consumes it. This is relevant to cache-aware long-context modeling, KV compression during training or distillation, and any architecture where the error metric should be tied to attention computation rather than raw vector reconstruction.","technical_approach":"WUSH-KV adapts the WUSH transform to KV caches. WUSH builds a closed-form invertible transform from the Gram matrix of the quantized factor and a Hessian induced by the other factor in a matrix product. For KV cache, the method builds separate transforms for keys and values. The key transform uses calibration statistics of keys and sensitivity from the query heads that consume them. The value transform uses value statistics and sensitivity from the output-projection blocks. The value-side transform can be folded into model weights, so it adds no online transform cost. The key-side transform and query compensation are applied after headwise normalization, when present, and after RoPE, matching the actual attention-score path. The transform is independent of the scalar quantizer and can be paired with clipped per-token quantizers. The method also keeps sink and recent cache entries in full precision to avoid damaging positions that carry disproportionate attention mass.","experiments":"The reported experiments show lower layerwise attention reconstruction error and lower perplexity than existing KV-cache quantization methods. In 2-bit downstream evaluation, WUSH-KV scores above OSCAR on all four Qwen3-8B tasks, and remains competitive on 4B and 32B models. The theoretical analysis focuses on QuEST INT and shows near-optimality of the ideal WUSH transform under an additive rounding-noise model plus assumptions on normalized tails and clipping errors. The provided content does not expose exact perplexity values, task scores, or latency numbers, so the main items to verify are calibration size, group size, number of full-precision sink/recent tokens, transform overhead, and whether memory savings translate into end-to-end throughput gains.","reading_guide":"Skim in 25–35 minutes. 负责保存和恢复模型对某段文本 prefill 后得到的 KV state；Blaise 负责在 CPU 侧把大文档切成 section，并在回答问题时只把相关 section 的原始文本送给模型。前者消除重复计算，后者减少不必要阅读，两者可以单独使用。\n\nTaliesin 的核心设计是 byte-exact memory。它把一段 prompt block 的 KV 状态按“输入字节串 + Recent parallel drafters have achieved breakthrough performance in frontier production models, but their effectiveness deteriorates as the entropy of target distributions increases due to insufficient draft diversity. block 内每个位置独立给候选 token；这一步保留了并行 drafter 的主要吞吐优势。selector 则不再做完整自回归修正，而是只学习相邻候选 token 对之间的 transition score，也就是 bigram 相关性。做法是利用 proposer 的 hidden states，再结合冻结 target embedding 经过两个独立 MLP 得到 fast, but they usually produce only one draft path. When the target distribution has high entropy, a single path is a poor approximation, and acceptance length drops. Existing fixes either reintroduce autoregressive correction, which hurts parallelism, or reuse single-path parallel drafters for tree verification, which creates a train–inference mismatch. The model is trained to produce the best single continuation, but inference needs several plausible branches that deserve verification budget. UBTree is designed to keep neural computation parallel while adding local dependency modeling and training directly for tree-style verification.","importance":"This is an inference paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is still relevant to foundation-model researchers for two reasons. Audio tokens draw much more attention there, and their ranking is still far from final, so audio needs a ranking before the language model runs. out","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"","category_id":"efficient","cover_url":"/covers/2609_38878.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.SD","cs.AI","cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是音频语言模型里一个很具体但很关键的瓶颈：音频 token 太长，既占 prefill 计算，也占上下文窗口，而现有 token pruning 方法大多依赖语言模型前几层的注意力来做裁剪，这对图像常常够用，但对音频不够。全文给出的核心观察是，音频 token 在语言模型早期层仍然被明显关注，而且此时它们的最终重要性排序还没有稳定下来，所以“先跑几层再裁”会错过最有价值的节省点。作者要解决的问题不是一般性的压缩，而是：能不能在语言模型尚未处理音频之前，仅凭音频编码器输出，就预测哪些 token 未来会在整个语言模型中持续获得高注意力，从而提前做安全裁剪。","importance":"对预训练和统一多模态建模的启发主要有三层。第一，它说明 encoder 输出里已经包含了相当强的“下游 LM 可用性”信号，LM 对音频 token 的长期注意力并不是完全在 decoder 内部才形成，这对音频 tokenizer、projector 设计、以及 encoder-LM 接口研究都有直接意义。第二，它把多模态 token 压缩从“中途裁剪”推进到“LM 之前裁剪”，这类思路对长语音、长视频、统一上下文预算都更有价值，因为只有前置裁剪才能同时省算力和省 context。第三，它给出一个很朴素但信息量很高的结论：在不少 LALM 上，未来全层注意力可以被线性解码出来。这意味着 encoder 表征与 LM 使用模式之间存在稳定的线性结构，后续完全可以把它当成预训练目标、蒸馏目标，或者作为 tokenizer 学习时的辅助信号。就贡献量级看，它不是改写建模范式的工作，但对音频 LM 的系统设计和训练接口有实用且可迁移的价值。","technical_approach":"方法很简单，关键在问题定义和验证做得扎实。作者先定义每个音频 token 的目标分数 g_i：它在整个语言模型所有层、所有头中，从音频位置接收到的总注意力。由于实验设定里问题放在音频之后，因果注意力下音频位置看不到问题，因此这个 g_i 不依赖具体问题内容，可以在问题到来前决定裁剪。随后作者发现，g_i 可以由 encoder 输出 e_i 通过一个线性映射 s_i = w^T e_i + b 预测出来，这个映射用闭式解拟合，不需要人工标签，也不需要额外训练一个复杂网络。这个线性预测器被称为 prior。\n\n在此基础上，Triage 采用两阶段裁剪。Stage 1 在 LM 运行前，按 prior 排序先裁掉一部分 token；这一步同时节省 prefill 和上下文占用。Stage 2 只在多选任务中使用：先让保留下来的 token 经过 LM 前两层，再利用此时观测到的注意力对排序做一次修正，再裁一次。作者强调，音频不适合像图像那样主要依赖中途裁剪，因为 layer 2 时音频 token 仍然高度活跃，且排序和最终排序相关性不高；所以 Stage 2 只是补充，而不是主力。\n\n全文还有几个技术点值得注意。其一，作者系统比较了多种“LM 运行前可得”的替代信号，包括位置、响度、self-information、encoder 自注意力等，发现这些信号对未来 LM 注意力的预测都明显弱于线性 prior。其二，他们做了控制变量分析，在控制位置、波形属性、词属性后，prior 的相关性仍保留 95% 到 97%，说明它不是简单地在偷用位置偏置或能量偏置。其三，作者还用删除实验验证 prior 的因果含义：删掉 prior 认为最重要的 token，会比删掉能量匹配或位置匹配的 token 更显著地恶化识别性能。这让“预测的是有用性而不只是统计相关”更可信。","experiments":"实验覆盖 13 个 LALM，其中 11 个模型上，线性 prior 对全层注意力排序的 Spearman 相关达到 ρ≥0.69；而响度、self-information、encoder attention 等常见启发式在 7 个模型上的最好结果不超过 |ρ|=0.31。这个差距说明可预测性不是来自简单声学显著性。\n\n作者先证明为什么图像 pruning 的经验不能直接搬到音频。以 Qwen3-Omni-30B 为例，在 layer 2，文本位置给音频的注意力占比是 16.2%，而给图像和视频分别只有 3.6% 和 3.9%。在同一段 RACE passage 上，把内容分别做成语音和渲染页面，音频在 layer 2 获得的注意力是页面的 2.3 倍（Qwen 30B）和 2.1 倍（Qwen 3B）；同时，layer 2 的当前排序与最终全层排序只有 ρ=0.39，说明“早层已排好序”这个前提不成立。\n\n任务结果分两类。转写任务上，在保守预算下，Triage 的 WER 与全音频相比差距控制在 0.04 以内；在激进预算下，它在 12 个转写设置里都优于所有 baseline，包括 mid-prefill 方案。多选任务上，在 2.2x 到 5x 压缩范围内，Triage 的平均准确率比平均最强基线 DART 高 0.043。系统收益方面，在 Qwen2.5-Omni-3B 上，2.86x 的前置裁剪把可容纳音频长度从 21.8 分钟提升到约 62 分钟；在 20 到 43 分钟的自然录音上，激进 Triage 优于直接截断到窗口长度、按 1 分钟窗口投票、以及同压缩率下的 DART。最激进设置下，单 GPU 可服务的并发流数提升 4 倍。\n\n这些结果的含义很明确：前置裁剪不是只在离线指标上好看，而是同时改善长音频可处理长度和在线服务吞吐。","reading_guide":"泛读时建议先抓三件事。第一，看 Introduction 和分析章节里关于“为什么音频不能照搬图像 token pruning”的证据，尤其是 layer 2 accurate on average. It asks a stricter question: can a low-precision fast matmul realization break prefix invariance in causal LMs? In a linear layer, rows of the activation matrix correspond to token positions. Fast algorithms such as Strassen mix rows across blocks and rely on exact cancellation of cross terms. Under low-precision quantization and rounding, those cancellations may fail, so later-token information can leak into earlier-token outputs. That violates prefix invariance: logits at a position should depend only on the allowed prefix, not on future text. This matters directly for likelihood-based multiple-choice scoring, packed inference, and any setting where one assumes row-local causal semantics. The core problem is therefore how to detect and construct low-precision fast matmul realizations that preserve the multiplication savings while provably retaining the row-local behavior of the classical operator.","importance":"For foundation-model research, the contribution matters in three ways. First, it exposes a failure mode that standard metrics can miss. Accuracy and perplexity do not certify prefix invariance. A kernel can look acceptable by ordinary task metrics and still change likelihood-based decisions because of future-token leakage. Second, it reframes numerical stability as a structural correctness issue, not just an error-magnitude issue. For low-precision inference, packed serving, and any cross-request batching scheme, preserving causal isolation is a stronger requirement than keeping average error small. Third, it provides a constructive certification route: instead of hoping rounding errors are small, it builds realizations whose outputs are bitwise identical to classical int8 matmul. Repeated generations on the same benchmark item produce different binary outcomes, so the benchmark score is an estimate of expected performance. Uniformly repeating every item ignores the fact that item-level rollout variances differ: items with pass probability near 0.5 are noisy, while items near 0 or 1 need fewer samples.","importance":"This is an evaluation-method paper with practical relevance to pretraining and post-training loops. The contribution is a statistically better allocation of the same generation budget, yielding tighter estimates without changing the benchmark or model.","technical_approach":"The method, Speculative Evaluation, uses a Hierarchical Bayesian Neyman policy. For item i with pass probability p_i, the rollout variance is p_i(1-p_i). Classical Neyman allocation would assign more samples to higher-variance items if these variances were known. HBN handles the unknown-variance case with a two-stage design. It first runs a small uniform pilot over all tasks, fits a hierarchical Bayesian model to pool noisy success counts, and uses posterior expected sampling variances as allocation scores. It then performs exact positive-integer Neyman allocation for the remaining budget while keeping at least one fresh continuation sample per task. Pilot size and stage weight are chosen before evaluation, and a weighted estimator reuses the pilot without bias. HBN-async adds a systems component: it speculatively launches continuations from partial pilot feedback and retains only requests selected by the final allocation, reducing idle time at the pilot barrier.","experiments":"Across 107 benchmark–checkpoint profiles and average rollout budgets of 8–64 per task, HBN reduces estimator variance by 12.8%–33.6% on average relative to Uniform. This is a useful warning for long-horizon agent evaluation and retrieval-augmented systems: majority agreement and semantic deduplication can both be misleading when sources are correlated.","technical_approach":"CPB has two modes. A fixed gold rule promotes claims only when enough independent support remains after lineage collapse. CPB-Live runs agents against an actual shared store. This differs from human preference scoring and from text-based relevance metrics. It also differs from forecasting benchmarks that only ask for the final prediction. LLM judges are now used for model selection, preference-data filtering, reward construction, and benchmark aggregation. If reliability metrics are dominated by close-rank-gap pairs, they can penalize judges for uncertainty that has little ranking cost, while missing errors on easy high-gap comparisons that do damage the final ordering. A flipped verdict on a close pair is almost free under the model and barely moves the maximum-likelihood ranking. A flipped verdict on a far pair has a large likelihood cost and pulls the recovered strengths in the wrong direction. This gives a common explanation for run-to-run inconsistency, position bias, and judge-human disagreement. 出发构造契约：包括 prompt 中暴露的工具说明、schema、返回值语义、任务文件和 evaluator 读取的字段。每条契约都要求绑定 provenance，也就是明确它依据的是哪一段接口表述，而不是审计者主观补充。随后用静态和动态两类检查去验证工具调用前后四元组 (pre, post, args, result) 是否满足契约。\n\n论文定义了六类可执行缺陷，其中比较关键的是 multi-hop reasoning itself. It asks a more basic question: do current multi-hop benchmarks actually measure dependence on the intended reasoning chain? Existing datasets often provide annotated hops and supporting evidence, and correct answers are commonly treated as evidence that the model composed those steps. The paper shows that this inference is weak. A model may answer correctly via memorized associations, an unannotated shorter path, partial evidence, or superficial cues. The core problem is therefore to separate annotated reasoning structure from behavioral reliance on that structure, and to build benchmarks where each intended step is genuinely necessary for successful answering.","importance":"Its main contribution is methodological rather than algorithmic. The four hazards are authority, injection, boundary, and fault. Authority checks whether a message from another person overrides the user. Injection checks whether planted text in a record redirects the agent. Boundary checks whether the agent moves into an app outside the granted task scope. Fault checks how the agent handles an ambiguous failed write. Each run receives the original state-based task-success verdict and an additional grading pass over seven failure modes. The policy separates pre-execution information from observed outcomes: a 17-dimensional context vector extracted from the task definition, a fixed impact score, per-trial failure observations, and measured resource use. The proposed policy is a risk-aware contextual Thompson Sampling method. Context helps prioritize likely high-impact scenarios before any execution has been observed, while posterior updates redirect budget as empirical failures or non-failures accumulate. The objective is impact-weighted failure discovery under a fixed budget, not reward maximization in the usual bandit sense. Baselines include uniform allocation, random allocation, failure-rate heuristics, static risk-aware allocation, arm-only Thompson Sampling, and an oracle upper bound.","experiments":"The evaluation uses offline replay over 70 τ-bench airline scenarios and 824 recorded trials. Network access is disabled during both implementation and grading, and dependencies are preinstalled in the task image. image-to-video 模型能延续物理运动，却很难根据角色的主观心理状态生成行为。作者把这个问题定义为 mental-state-to-behavior reasoning，即给定同一个世界状态，只通过文本注入角色的感知、信念或欲望，不显式给动作词，要求模型自己推出接下来会做什么。全文反复强调，传统 I2V 评测大多考察显式动作对齐或物理连续性，无法区分模型是在做真正的心理状态推断，还是只是在复现常见动作模式。","importance":"对基座预训练本身的直接贡献不强，它更接近视频生成评测资产，而不是训练方法或建模范式创新。但它提出的问题有研究价值：如果未来想把 world model、视频生成模型和通用 agent 统一起来，模型不能只会“看见世界怎么动”，还得会“理解角色为什么这么动”。文中提出的 Omniscient Bias 也有启发性：模型往往依据全局可见真相生成行为，而不是依据角色局部可见信息或错误信念。这和多模态模型里常见的视角绑定失败、主体知识边界不清是同一类问题。对做统一多模态预训练的人来说，这个 benchmark 更像一个诊断工具，用来暴露模型是否真正学到了带主体视角的因果表征。","technical_approach":"方法上有三个关键设计。第一，作者用 BDI-P 框架组织任务空间，把 latent mental variables 分成 Perception、Belief、Desire 三大类，再细分到 12 个二级维度和 34 个子维度。这样做的目的，是把“心理状态”从模糊概念变成可系统枚举的控制变量。第二，提出 Zero-Action Prompting：文本只描述角色的内部状态，不出现动作词，让模型不能靠 prompt 中的 verb 直接匹配视频模板，而必须从心理状态推到意图，再到动作。第三，采用 counterfactual 配对设计。每个世界状态固定，只最小化改动一个心理变量，比如 true belief 改成 false belief，或者看见/没看见某个物体。这样如果模型在两条 prompt 上都能生成对应差异化行为，才更能说明它在追踪 latent state，而不是碰巧生成了合理动作。\n\n评测管线也做得比较完整。作者没有只看视频质量，而是用一个自动化的大视觉模型评估流程，从 visual quality、commonsense plausibility、intention accuracy、world-state maintenance 四个维度打分，并用结构化推理 prompt 让评估模型先分析再判定。全文还做了 100 个视频的人类专家对照，说明自动评测与 10 位专家汇总判断有较强一致性。这个设计的意义在于，mental-state-conditioned generation 很难靠单一 caption similarity 或 VQA 指标衡量，必须把“动作是否合理”“是否符合角色主观状态”“是否保持原始世界状态”拆开看。","experiments":"数据集规模是 372 张专家设计图像、744 条 prompt，对应成对的 counterfactual 设置。作者评测了 11 个主流模型，包括 Veo 3.1、Kling V3、Wan 2.6、CogVideoX 等。主要结论很明确：这些模型在视觉保真和物理常识上表现尚可，但在 mental-state consistency 上明显掉队。也就是说，模型能生成“看起来像那么回事”的动作，却经常不是角色在该心理状态下应做的动作。\n\n全文最有信息量的实验观察是 Omniscient Bias。比如 false-belief 场景里，角色错误地以为物体还在盒子里，合理行为应是去打开空盒子；但模型常按客观真相生成行为，直接去找物体真实所在位置。这说明模型没有把“世界真实状态”和“角色主观信念状态”分开建模。作者还指出，counterfactual paired evaluation 比单条 prompt 成功率更严格，也更能过滤偶然命中。摘要里没有给出完整数值表，但从正文描述看，领先模型之间差距存在，然而整体都没有跨过这个认知门槛：物理合理性高于心理一致性，且在 belief/perception 相关子类上退化最明显。","reading_guide":"泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1、Figure 2，抓住作者到底在评什么：不是动作跟随，不是物理续写，而是从 belief、partial observability、desire conflict 这类最容易暴露模型缺陷的设置。最后看 human agreement 部分，确认自动评测是否站得住。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以把主要设计和结论读清楚。若只关心对多模态预训练的启发，重点盯住 Omniscient Bias 这一现象，以及作者如何通过固定 world state、只改 mental This differs from dense attention alignment and all-head regularization, both of which assume that all heads should follow the same visual supervision.","experiments":"The paper evaluates the method on multiple MLLMs and six multimodal benchmark suites. Its main signal is that sparse autoencoder features can be used as an active inference-time interface, not only as a post-hoc interpretability tool. It also frames some VLM failures as evidence-binding and representational-interference problems, rather than pure perception failures. This is relevant to native multimodal pretraining and visual tokenization, where the structure of intermediate representations matters.","technical_approach":"NeuronEye has three components. Sparse Neuron Space trains a sparse autoencoder on frozen intermediate vision-token activations. A d-dimensional patch state is projected into an overcomplete latent space D=αd, followed by ReLU sparsification, and the resulting neurons are clustered into concept-level groups. Neuron-guided Visual Focus uses both the text query and image-side evidence to select relevant clusters, localize the patches where these concepts are expressed, and inject the activated evidence back into the corresponding vision tokens. Perceptual Concept Suppression is applied at a later layer to attenuate dominant perceptual directions, so that focused activation does not wash out weaker but relevant cues. The difference from token pruning or generic representation steering is that the intervention is routed through a sparse concept vocabulary. The VLM backbone and the SAE remain frozen, and inference is still a single forward pass.","experiments":"The evaluation covers four vision-centric benchmarks and two backbones. Similar trends are reported on LLaVA-1.6-7B, especially on spatial and relational subtasks. Under a controlled protocol, NeuronEye outperforms visual-token reduction and representation-level intervention baselines on CV-Bench and BLINK. This matters for spatial tasks because some steps benefit from maintaining several plausible scene interpretations, while other steps require a sharper commitment. prompt polishing. It reframes prompt enhancement for text-to-video as a planning problem: given a short user request, generate a shot-structured cinematic plan that stays coherent over time and preserves user intent across subjects, actions, camera motion, lighting, dialogue, audio, and event order. The authors argue that standard forward prompt rewriting is trained on a synthetic rewrite distribution, while downstream video generators are conditioned on captions grounded in real videos. As generation length reaches 30 seconds, this mismatch becomes a real modeling issue rather than a stylistic one. The resulting failures are omissions, broken subject-action bindings, temporal contradictions, and poor cross-shot coherence. The paper therefore targets two coupled problems: learning a planning distribution closer to real filmed structure, and maintaining semantic fidelity throughout a long multi-shot plan.","importance":"Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from the training formulation rather than the video application itself. First, supervision is obtained through reverse construction from real videos instead of synthetic forward rewriting. That is a meaningful shift in how training targets are defined. Second, long-range semantic preservation is made explicit in RL through a multi-dimensional reward that penalizes omissions, altered constraints, wrong bindings, and temporal inconsistency. This is closely related to issues in long-context instruction following, structured generation, and agent trajectory consistency. diagnostic and training-signal intervention for diffusion distillation, rather than a new backbone. It is useful for pretraining researchers because it shows that distillation gradients can have strong spectral imbalance even when the scalar loss looks normal. It also demonstrates a low-intrusion way to reshape the optimization path without changing the teacher, the generator architecture, or inference-time sampling. The same type of analysis may be relevant to video, audio, and unified multimodal diffusion distillation.","technical_approach":"The method builds on Distribution Matching Distillation. DMD trains a few-step generator by minimizing a time-weighted reverse KL between the generator marginal and the target diffusion marginal. The generator update is driven by the difference between a frozen real score model and a trainable fake score model. SAP-DMD inserts a frequency-domain operation on this directional field. It applies a 2D FFT, adaptively suppresses excessive upper-tail amplitudes in the spectrum, preserves the phase, and transforms the field back before applying the update. The design avoids directly amplifying high frequencies, which could inject noise, and avoids changing the DMD objective or its fixed point. The main idea is to reduce the disproportionate effect of dominant low-frequency components so that mid- and high-frequency corrections receive more effective optimization signal.","experiments":"The experiments cover text-to-image distillation on PixArt-α, SD3, and SD3.5, with both 2-step and 4-step sampling. Pr","starred":false,"priority":"p3","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"","category_id":"multimodal_gen","cover_url":"/covers/2609_36638.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.CV"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是一个很具体但常被系统工程绕过去的问题：文生图模型在面对用户的短提示词时，往往理解不充分，因此工业系统会在推理时先用 distillation 在生成动力学上的作用。对于 flow matching 这类连续轨迹模型，学生真正会访问的是自己在 raw prompt 条件下走到的状态；如果监督来自 teacher 自己的轨迹，训练和推理分布会错位。论文的贡献量级更像是一个干净的方法设计和训练范式补丁，而不是改变文生图主干范式的工作。对 LLM p，教师模型接收 p+。训练时不是让学生去拟合教师在教师自身轨迹上的输出，而是先让学生在 raw prompt 条件下沿自己的 vector field 采样出 on-policy 轨迹；然后在这些由学生访问到的状态上，调用 enhanced-prompt teacher 计算对应的目标 vector field，学生再去匹配这个目标。这样做有两个关键点。\n\n第一，监督对象是 flow dynamics，而不是最终图像或额外构造的 text-image pair。论文强调它不同于 SFT：SFT 通常需要把 enhanced prompt 当成新的训练文本条件，甚至要重新组织图文对；而这里不需要新增配对数据，只是把 PE 作为训练时的条件增强信号。\n\n第二，teacher 和 student 的不对称只体现在条件上，不体现在任务定义上。teacher 不是一个完全不同的模型家族，而是同一 flow-matching 体系下、在更强文本条件下给出更 informed 的 vector field。这样蒸馏的是“在同一生成状态下，若文本条件更充分，模型会往哪里走”。这比直接蒸馏最终样本更细粒度，也更适合 flow matching。\n\n从全文表述看，作者还把它放在 self-distillation 框架里：teacher 可以是 base model 的 stop-gradient/EMA 视角，而不是必须单独训练一个大教师。方法比较的对象主要有三类：推理时直接加 PE、用 enhanced prompt 做 SFT、以及 off-policy distillation。作者的论点是，PE-OPSD 同时避免了推理时外挂 PE 的延迟，也避免了 off-policy 监督的状态分布错位。\n\n如果从预训练研究的语言来理解，这篇工作的抽象形式是：训练时给 teacher 更多条件信息，student 只看部署时可用的弱条件；监督发生在 student 自己会访问到的状态上，而不是静态数据分布上。这一点比“prompt enhancement”这个具体应用更值得记。","experiments":"从给出的全文内容看，实验结论是明确的，但可见的数字不多。作者声称在三种主干 flow-matching backbone 上，PE-OPSD 在 aggregate prompt fidelity 上都优于三类基线：1）推理时直接使用 Prompt Enhancer；2）SFT；3）off-policy distillation。同时，视觉吸引力指标保持正向变化，并且推理延迟回到 base model 水平，因为部署时不再需要 PE 和 teacher。\n\n实验设计上，最值得注意的不是单个分数，而是比较维度比较完整：\n1. 与 inference-time PE 比，检验“能否把外挂模块的收益内化”；\n2. 与 SFT 比，检验“仅用 enhanced prompt 重新训练文本条件是否足够”；\n3. 与 off-policy distillation 比，检验“on-policy 状态对齐是否关键”。\n\n按方法逻辑推断，关键消融应包括：是否使用 on-policy 轨迹、teacher 是否使用 enhanced prompt、teacher/student 是否共享参数或用 EMA、不同 backbone 上的一致性、以及对短提示和欠指定提示的分层分析。论文摘要和引言已经给出主结论：on-policy 监督优于 off-policy，说明学生访问状态分布的匹配确实重要；优于 SFT，说明单纯把增强文本塞进训练集并不能等价替代动态蒸馏；优于 inference-time PE，说明模型确实学到了一部分“从短提示恢复更完整生成行为”的能力，而不是只依赖外部改写器。\n\n由于当前提供的全文片段没有完整实验表格、具体 backbone 名称、数据集和精确数值，无法安全补充参数量、训练步数或绝对提升幅度。阅读原文时应重点核对这些数字，尤其是 aggregate prompt fidelity If the assessment is valid and a=0, the critique is used to form a revised or privileged prompt. During training, the student policy conditions only on the original prompt and rolls out its own sampling trajectory. The teacher is an EMA version of the same model, but it conditions on the privileged prompt. The objective minimizes a per-state divergence between the student and teacher denoising or flow distributions along the student’s own trajectory. projector 解决 hidden size 不同，再最小化层间 latent alignment loss。作者发现这种 recipe 有两个结构性缺陷。第一，按深度配层默认“相同相对深度的层做相同工作”，但 J-Lens 分析显示 teacher 与 student 的答案读出模式并不一致：teacher 的最终答案主要在最后两层才显化，student Confidence is defined as the geometric mean of the token probabilities assigned to that trial answer, i.e. a length-normalized likelihood under the model’s own distribution. It does not require gold labels or an external judge, and it is not treated as a calibrated probability of correctness. Fine-tuning examples then train the model to predict this confidence from the intermediate reasoning state. Reasoning tokens are masked out of the loss; only the confidence target is supervised. le","starred":true,"priority":"p1","reading_tier":"must_read","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2609_37633.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.AI","cs.CL","stat.ML"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这项工作处理的是 self-generated insight token 打开 backpropagation mask。每条 insight 约 17 个 token，作为用户消息插入上下文，但训练时允许这些 token 承担 SFT-style loss。这样模型学习的不是“生成某个最终答案”，而是从任务描述映射到一个高层提醒。GRPO loss 仍可作用在 rollout action token 上，使用 映射的参数化，而不是来自成功 rollout token 的传统策略梯度更新。","reading_guide":"建议精读 Introduction 和 Methods。Introduction 里对 RLVR 失效条件的描述很重要：不是 verifier 不好，而是成功样本概率太低导致没有可学习优势。Methods 里要重点看两个 mask：rollout action token 如何进入 It directly measures the degree of decision change at the token level using hindsight feedback, significantly improving the rollout efficiency of RL training. This provides a low-cost, high-return exploration mechanism for RL pre-training/post-training in long reasoning and Agent tasks.","technical_approach":"The core idea of HDL is to use 'Hindsight-Divergence' to locate branch points. The process: 1) Sample a small number of complete trajectories (roots) and obtain verification feedback; 2) The model generates a hindsight reflection based on the feedback; 3) Use the feedback and reflection as a hindsight context to recalculate the log-likelihood of each token in the root trajectory; 4) Compare the token log-likelihoods under the original and hindsight contexts, calculating the absolute difference (the hindsight-divergence score); 5) Select the positions with the highest scores as branch points, retain the prefix, and resample subsequent trajectories to fill the training group. This concentrates exploration on critical decision points where the model 'changes its mind' after receiving feedback.","experiments":"Evaluated three models across math, code, and Agent tasks. Instead of treating self-evolution failure as only a verifier problem, a data-diversity problem, or a solver problem, the paper proposes a round-level signal that estimates whether the new data still contains information that the model can learn. This is relevant to continual pretraining, synthetic SFT data, RL data generation, and self-training pipelines, where the main operational question is when to continue, reweight, refresh the data source, or stop.","technical_approach":"The central quantity is learnable information gain. A small language model is fit to the data from round t−1 and then used to score both round t−1 and round t data with negative log-likelihood. If the new round has higher NLL under the previous-round model, it contains content that the previous distribution does not explain. Under an exact distributional fit, the quantity decomposes into KL divergence between the two round distributions plus the change in entropy. This separates distribution shift from diversity change. The proposed ATRI module uses the signal in two ways: within a round, samples with above-average information gain receive larger weights; across rounds, training stops when the gain remains below a threshold for consecutive rounds.","experiments":"The paper reports evaluations on several common self-evolution datasets and compares ATRI against filtering- and regularization-based baselines. The key empirical claim is that learnable information gain tracks saturation before visible performance degradation, and that ATRI mitigates degeneration through novelty-aware reweighting and early stopping. The provided content does not expose the exact datasets, model sizes, round counts, or numerical gains, so the magnitude of the improvement should be checked directly in the experimental tables. The most important ablations are whether reweighting and stopping each contribute independently, and whether the gain signal remains predictive across tasks rather than only matching one benchmark.","reading_guide":"A 20–30 minute skim is sufficient. Read the formal definition of learnable information gain and its KL-plus-entropy decomposition first. SIPO shows a clean way to combine outcome-level RL direction with token-level self-distillation inside one advantage estimator. This matters for the pretrain–posttrain interface: dense supervision does not have to come from an external teacher, and it does not have to replace policy optimization with imitation. It can be injected as a local credit-assignment term while keeping reward optimization as the main driver.","technical_approach":"The method builds a contrastive self-teacher. At each iteration, the current policy samples a group of rollouts for each prompt and receives binary environment rewards. For every rollout, SIPO constructs two teacher contexts: one with the reference answer and one with a mistake from the group, often the rollout’s own wrong answer. The model then scores the same response under both contexts without generating new text. The token-level signal is the difference between the two teacher log-probabilities. A token receives positive credit when it is more likely under the correct context than under the mistaken context. This contrastive feedback is clipped and added to the GRPO group-relative advantage, yielding a token-level advantage for policy optimization. Compared with OPSD, the contrastive form reduces the impact of an overconfident self-teacher and mitigates excessive penalties on long reasoning traces. Compared with vanilla RLVR, it can still train on groups where every rollout receives zero reward.","experiments":"The evaluation covers STEM reasoning and code generation. Retrieval should improve first so that useful evidence becomes available, and only then can the policy reliably learn when to search and how to reason over the returned information. span。对于正 advantage 的 token，如果对应 claim 在反事实图像下能明显 retract，就保留完整正信用；如果 claim 异常 persistent，即证据被破坏后仍维持高支持度，则衰减其正信用。负 advantage token 和非 routed token 不做改动。这样设计很克制：它不直接惩罚所有视觉 token，也不需要 claim 的人工真值标签，只是在“本来会被奖励”的位置上做选择性减弱。作者强调 PACG 可组合到 DAPO、VPPO 这类现有 RLVR 优化器上，而且没有推理时额外开销。\n\n和已有 perception reward、token reweighting、multimodal PRM 的区别在于，这篇工作不主要问“哪些 token 看了图”，而是问“这些 token verifiable rewards. A model can produce the correct final answer while still making direct visual claims that are not supported by the image, such as wrong counts, OCR values, or geometric properties. Because outcome-level RL rewards the whole trajectory, these unsupported claims inherit positive credit whenever the final answer is correct. The authors argue that existing perception-aware methods mostly measure whether the model depends on the image, but that is different from asking whether a specific visual claim would be withdrawn if the supporting evidence were removed. They therefore separate two notions: Evidence-Function Sensitivity (how much token predictions change under image intervention) and claim persistence (whether support for the same claim remains after the relevant visual evidence is disrupted). Their central finding is that the two can move in different directions.","importance":"This is a post-training paper rather than a pretraining one, but it has clear relevance for foundation-model research. First, it warns against treating stronger input sensitivity as evidence of better grounding. That matters for multimodal objective design more broadly. Second, it pushes RL credit assignment from token-level broadcasting toward claim-level reasoning, and does so without requiring manual supported-versus-unsupported labels during training. That idea could transfer beyond vision, for example to retrieval evidence, tool outputs, or reasoning traces. The contribution is best viewed as a careful correction to multimodal RLVR training signals, especially for readers interested in hallucination, grounding, and process-level supervision.","technical_approach":"$108","experiments":"$109","reading_guide":"For a skim, start with the definitions of direct visual claim, EFS, and claim persistence. In this coordinate system, the expected GRPO update is uniform, the probability of a zero-variance group is bounded by Gaussian boundary layers, and the evidence noise of the pass rate is homoscedastic. Arcus uses a Kalman filter to track the state of each prompt in the arc length coordinate system, handles mixed groups with variance-stabilized observations, and handles zero-variance groups with boundary-layer likelihood. Prompts are scored by their overlap with an objective-matched Gaussian kernel multiplied by the probability of generating an informative group. A target pacing rule is also designed to dynamically adjust the training objective.","experiments":"On three backbone models, Arcus beats 9 prompt-selection baselines. Compared to Dynamic Sampling (DS), Arcus outperforms it while using 48-57% fewer rollouts, and reaches DS's final accuracy with 70% fewer rollouts. Ablation studies isolate and prove the effectiveness of the arc length coordinate, the Gaussian kernel, and the pacing rule.","reading_guide":"Highly recommend reading Section 3 (The Geometry of Pass Rates under GRPO), which is the soul of this paper. In GRPO-style training, rewards are centered and normalized within a group. The leaf exposes the final question or target information. Training uses a curriculum RL strategy: it starts with simpler trees, then increases tree depth and reasoning complexity. The final Compositional StateTree variant attaches step-level semantic fragments to tree edges, requiring the model to aggregate fragments along the path into a coherent query. The standard recipe treats the teacher output as chosen and the student's own output as rejected. The key point is that DPO-style learning depends heavily on the reject distribution, not only on the quality of chosen responses. A self reject from the post-SeqKD student may be a near miss that is already likely under the reference policy, giving DPO a weak contrast. A finite-horizon utility bound motivates a favorable region where useful transfer is large and harmful transfer is small. stu","starred":false,"priority":"p3","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2609_39757.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.CV"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是 on-policy 黑盒蒸馏里一个很具体但很关键的接口问题：critic 学到的奖励，未必适合直接拿去做 GRPO 的组内 advantage。已有对抗式黑盒蒸馏方法把 critic 训练成“区分 teacher 响应和 student 响应”的判别器，但 student 更新时真正用到的是“同一 prompt 下多条 student 采样之间的相对奖励”。这两件事不是一回事。前者只要求 teacher 分高、student 分低；后者要求 student 组内奖励有稳定的排序、足够的间隔、合适的尺度。若组内 reward geometry 退化，比如分数塌缩、边际很小、对噪声敏感，那么 advantage 会很脆，GRPO 的更新信号就会失真。论文要解决的就是这个 critic 目标与 grouped policy optimization 的接口设计。","technical_approach":"方法叫 GRGC，分两段做。第一段是 critic-side geometry calibration。作者观察到，原始 critic 只做 teacher-vs-student 判别时，student 组内分数可能虽然整体低于 teacher，但彼此挤在一起，导致排序容易翻转。为此，他们在 critic 训练时加入 Gaussian groupwise Optimal Transport calibration：对每个 prompt 下 student 样本的 reward 排序后，与一组以 0 为中心的 Gaussian quantiles 对齐。这样做不是为了把 reward 拟合成高斯分布本身，而是为了强制组内分数形成非退化的 spread、平滑的 rank gap 和稳定的 scale。选 Gaussian quantiles 的原因也讲得比较清楚：它提供对称、适中、连续的间隔，比硬 margin 或手工分桶更平滑，也比完全自由的分布更容易控制。\n\n第二段是 policy-side group modulation。经过 critic 侧校准后，作者对每个组的 reward 做中心化和尺度标准化，再施加 signed power transform，放大有信息的组内差异，同时保持排序不变。这里的设计目标不是重新定义 reward，而是改善 advantage 的可分性，让 GRPO 在组内 softmax/相对比较时更稳。文中还给了几个命题来说明这一点：在 grouped softmax surrogate 下，advantage gap 直接决定一步更新后的 pairwise log-odds shift；而 advantage 误差会在 clipped GRPO surrogate 中带来有界失真。换句话说，reward geometry 不是外围细节，而是直接进入 policy update 的核心量。\n\n和已有方法相比，GAD 之类主要把精力放在 critic 判别能力上；GRGC 则把重点放在“critic 输出如何被 GRPO 消化”。它不是换一个更强 reward model，也不是改 teacher 查询方式，而是在 critic 训练目标和 policy 侧 reward 使用方式之间加了一层几何条件化。","experiments":"从给出的全文内容看，实验设计覆盖了不同 teacher、不同 student 家族与规模、不同训练数据，并同时报告了 in-distribution 与 out-of-distribution 结果，还使用了不同 If acquisition ignores judge deviations, the learned reward can be precise in the wrong directions and downstream RL can amplify those errors.","technical_approach":"The method, Nuisance-Adjusted Optimal Design, models human preference with a Bradley-Terry reward model using fixed response features and pairwise comparison features. The central idea is to jointly estimate the target human reward and judge-specific deviation parameters, then select comparisons using the target information that remains after accounting for target-nuisance cross-information. A comparison is less useful if the same label variation could plausibly be explained by judge bias. This work makes the cost of corrupted comparisons explicit under a tail-risk objective, with dependence on the corruption budget C, risk level α, feature dimension d, and preference-link parameter κ. Each episode produces one comparison between the executed trajectory and a fixed feasible reference; the reward is additive and linear in known features; clean comparisons follow a generalized linear preference model; an adversary may flip at most C labels over K episodes. The key mechanism is to downweight comparisons whose feature directions are poorly estimated before observing the current label. This caps the self-normalized influence of any flipped label, allowing the aggregate corruption effect to be absorbed into the reward confidence radius. The resulting reward confidence set is then used in augmented-state CVaR planning. This differs from repeated-query defenses and from robust expected-return RLHF because the analysis must propagate reward-estimation uncertainty through the lower tail of the return distribution.","experiments":"The main contribution is theoretical. With known transitions and normalized linear rewards, the regret bound is O~(d/κ * sqrt(K/α) + dC/(κ α)). The first term is the clean statistical term; the second is the corruption penalty. When C=0, the bound reduces to O~(d/κ * sqrt(K/α)); when α=1, static CVaR becomes expected return and the leading dependence matches clean contextual dueling-bandit guarantees. The evidence suggests that superposition linearity is stronger at initialization and weakens during language-model pretraining. This makes it more like an architectural bias than a capability learned by next-token prediction. The result is relevant to residual-stream geometry, feature interference, parallel stream processing, and the way the pretraining objective reshapes initially linear computation paths.","technical_approach":"The setup is simple. For two equal-length sequences A and B, the authors average their token embeddings position by position and feed the mixed embedding sequence into an unchanged decoder-only Transformer. If superposition linearity holds, the output distribution for the mixed input should approximate 0.5(P_A + P_B), where P_A and P_B are the next-token distributions from separate forward passes. The paper measures this through rank preservation of the tokens preferred by the individual streams and through distributional divergence between the mixed output and the averaged output. To separate architectural bias from learned behavior, the authors track the phenomenon across pretraining checkpoints, especially using Pythia-style trajectories. They also show that a small fine-tuning phase can restore much of the degraded linearity, and they use the restored property to design a decoding procedure that disentangles the mixed hidden state into continuations for the two original streams.","experiments":"The experiments cover several model families, including Pythia, Qwen, Llama, OLMo, and Gemma, and use both TinyStories and FineWeb. Second, tracking pretraining shows that superposition fidelity is highest near initialization and tends to decrease as language modeling training progresses. Third, lightweight fine-tuning using less than 0.025% of the original pretraining data size substantially reduces the divergence between the mixed distribution and the average of the individual distributions. The paper also reports a correlation between hidden-state feature additivity and output-level rank preservation, linking geometric linearity to end-to-end behavior.","reading_guide":"Skim in 20-30 minutes. landscapes, or by other issues such as noisy credit assignment, weak exploration, and the dynamics of policy updates.","importance":"The useful contribution is conceptual and diagnostic. In a controlled tabular setting, the authors show that some RLVR landscapes for iterated group and quasigroup multiplication are benign: they contain no suboptimal local maxima under specific assumptions. This separates two failure modes that are often conflated in practice. A run may fail not because the reward surface is full of traps, but because the policy update cannot diffuse across equal-reward deterministic codes, or because the signal-to-noise ratio is too poor without strong regularization and curriculum. That distinction is relevant for reasoning-RL recipes in language models.","technical_approach":"The main tool is a mapping from entropy-regularized RLVR to a spin-glass-like energy model over deterministic policies. Deterministic policies are treated as codes, or spin configurations. The paper establishes three links: local reward maxima are continuously connected to deterministic policies without crossing a loss barrier; the entropy-regularized RLVR objective is lower-bounded by the free energy of the corresponding spin model; and trapped configurations under local spin dynamics approximately match RLVR fixed points. The task family is iterated group or quasigroup multiplication: the policy receives a sequence of elements, emits one intermediate token per step, and receives reward only when the final product is correct. The first model class is a bounded-window myopic tabular policy, chosen to expose properties of the RLVR objective before adding transformer parameterization effects.","experiments":"The theoretical result is that, for simple untied models with uncorrelated inputs, the reward landscape has no suboptimal local maxima. For parity, the authors derive closed-form free energies at arbitrary temperature and depth T, and identify a first-order transition at large T between random and correct codes. Numerically, a simple Monte Carlo sampler over the spin model solves the untied tasks without curriculum. In contrast, exact local RLVR policy updates can fail in the same setting, because they do not move effectively across flat equal-reward regions. Across all nine model-dataset settings, created flips are roughly five times as frequent as resolved flips. For LLM pretraining and post-training research, the message is concrete. Long-form reasoning is not only an accuracy mechanism; it can reshape decision boundaries and confidence. A visible chain of thought should not be treated as automatically safer or more auditable, because the trace itself can be the place where bias is introduced and amplified.","technical_approach":"The study uses a within-model thinking-versus-non-thinking ablation on QwQ-32B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, and Qwen3-32B, evaluated on Adult, COMPAS, and Credit. The first instrument is a four-cell contingency table over counterfactual pairs: no flip in either mode, flip resolved by thinking, flip created by thinking, and flip in both modes. This directly separates repaired bias from newly introduced bias. The second instrument is CDPG, Counterfactual Depth Probability Gap. Each thinking trace is split into K=10 equal-token segments; prefixes are fed back to the model with an answer-elicitation suffix, and the probability gap between the two counterfactual sides is measured as a function of reasoning depth. The third instrument is BTM, Bias Transition Matrix, which tracks how pair-level states move from non-thinking to thinking. The technical novelty is the combination of a counterfactual-pair audit with trace-depth probing, which exposes dynamics that final-answer metrics miss.","experiments":"The empirical scope is three 32B-class open reasoning models times three decision datasets, giving nine settings. In every setting, thinking has a dual effect: it repairs some non-thinking counterfactual flips while creating substantially more new ones. The created-to-resolved ratio is about 5:1, and many created flips occur at very high model confidence. CDPG shows that counterfactual probability gaps tend to propagate and grow as the trace becomes deeper. The paper also reports an anchor/mover pattern: one side of a counterfactual pair often keeps its initial prediction, while the other side drifts toward the opposite decision boundary during thinking. BTM analysis indicates that protected-group marginal transitions can look similar across sides, while joint pair-state transitions are asymmetric. That pair-level asymmetry explains why creation dominates resolution. The key lesson is that statistical stopping rules are not enough when the party producing samples has a financial incentive to manipulate the sample sequence. This also affects training-data generation: many SFT and RL pipelines rely on multi-sample reasoning traces, voting, and verification, so unverifiable compute records can distort both data quality control and cost accounting.","technical_approach":"The authors model self-consistency as independent sampling from a model’s answer distribution over a finite answer set, followed by selecting the empirical mode. Adaptive stopping rules decide when the current counts are sufficient to identify the final answer. The proposed attack keeps generating additional reasoning paths and strategically reorders the disclosed sequence. When an auditor replays the provider’s stopping rule on that sequence, the process appears not to have been able to stop earlier, making the inflated path count look justified. The paper proves that, under natural count-based stopping rules, the attack can add a nontrivial number of generations and provides a lower bound on the expected number of extra samples. of a pre-execution decision. The central issue is that in a multi-action setting, moving the model away from a wrong action does not guarantee that it moves to the correct action, nor that it preserves decisions that were already correct.","importance":"The paper is not a pretraining-method contribution, but it is relevant to agentic post-training and mechanistic evaluation. It argues that tool-use failures should be modeled as directional error channels, such as correct-action-to-baseline-action pairs, rather than as a binary tool/no-tool mistake. This matters for SFT, RL, and representation-level control because aggregate accuracy can hide collateral damage and error redistribution. The work is also a useful caution: linear decodability of an internal state does not imply reliable steerability.","technical_approach":"The proposed framework, SAKIKO, treats representation repair as an evidence pipeline. It includes directional error discovery, per-input detection of channel-associated states, router-conditioned intervention, destination-resolved verification over the full K-way action space, and statistical licensing under pre-specified rules. The action space includes direct response, API/tool call, clarification request, and task declination. An error channel is represented as an ordered pair c = y* → ŷ0, where y* is the reference action and ŷ0 is the frozen model’s baseline action. Interventions are keyed to channels and applied only when the router fires. The important methodological choice is to verify the destination of the intervention, not just whether the original error disappeared. The framework also checks whether the intervention corrupts examples that were originally correct.","experiments":"The experiments cover seven LLMs across five model families, using tool-decision benchmarks including When2Call and MetaTool. 变成模型原生能力，让模型自己决定保留什么、删除什么、如何重写上下文，而不是把这些策略硬编码在系统外层。","importance":"对基座预训练的直接关系不如对 agent/serving 强，但它触到一个很重要的接口：上下文不再只是被动输入，而是模型可操作的状态。这个视角对未来的长上下文预训练、外部记忆建模、持续交互式训练都有启发。论文的贡献主要有三层。第一，提出 CLM 这个建模接口，把 等工具直接编辑这个 context file；编辑结果会立即同步回下一轮上下文。这样模型可以做 in-place update、删除冗余、维护表格、写内部备忘、为多代理维护多个上下文文件。这个接口自然支持 multi-agent：不同 agent 或 subagent 可以拥有各自 context file，并由模型协调读写。论文还补了两个系统层面的关键点。其一，提出 prefix-reuse FLOPs，用来衡量在标准 serving 下，因中间编辑导致的 re-prefill 成本，而不是只看单步 decode 成本。其二，提出 Suffix Cache Reuse，试图在发生中间编辑后复用不止前缀的缓存，减少重新 prefilling 的代价，同时经验上不损伤任务表现。训练方面，作者把 CLM 接到 stepwise GRPO，并设计 success-gated efficiency advantage：先要求任务成功，再在成功轨迹中偏好更省计算的上下文管理策略。这一点很关键，因为如果直接奖励省 token，模型容易走向过度压缩或丢信息；success-gated 先保正确性，再比效率，奖励信号更稳。除此之外，论文还引入 ContextBench，把 context management 从知识和推理能力中剥离出来，专门测选择性保留、原地更新、KV 作为节点持久化保存，同时保留时间顺序和引用关系。这样做的目的，是让“当前没放进上下文”的结果也不会丢失，后面还能被重新取回。\n\n第二是 Tool-Flow Analysis，简称 TFA。这是文章最关键的部分。它分析后续模型步骤和 tool 调用里出现的值，追踪这些值最早由哪个 tool result 引入，再把这种从早期结果到后续操作的连接记录成 observed renderer。每次模型调用前，renderer 在固定 token budget 内选择哪些历史 tool result 以完整形式放回上下文。打分信号由三类组成：observed reuse、recency、semantic relevance。未被选中的结果不会被删除，只是暂时不显示，仍保留在 graph 中供后续恢复。这个设计比一次性 summary 更稳，因为 summary 往往会丢掉后面才知道重要的细节。\n\n从方法取舍看，这篇工作没有走“让模型自己决定怎么压缩”的路线，也没有做复杂的 learned memory controller，而是用显式结构化状态和规则化信号来管理上下文。这样做的优点是可解释、可恢复、部署简单；代价是 TFA 对值流追踪的覆盖率和鲁棒性会决定上限，尤其当复用不是字面值级别，而是抽象语义级别时，信号可能不完整。","experiments":"实验在两个 benchmark 上做：AppWorld，以及 8-objective QA；执行模型用了三种。论文主结果集中在一个 primary 6K history budget 设定，也就是给 agent 先前执行历史分配 6K token Each turn yields a transition consisting of the current observation, selected action, next observation, and optional feedback. From informative transitions, the learner extracts a hypothesis with three fields: an applicability condition, a policy, and an expected effect. The hypothesis is split into two copies. A runtime copy is available immediately from the next step within the same episode. A candidate copy is stored but cannot guide future episodes until it is validated. During validation, compatible hidden candidates register predictions before the agent acts; later observations provide evidence for or against the predicted effect. The source episode is excluded, and each later episode contributes at most one conclusive verdict per item. Candidates with enough support and predictive precision are promoted to verified memory. This turns sparse task feedback into testable intermediate predictions.","experiments":"The paper evaluates over five rounds on WebArena-Lite and ALFWorld. With GPT-5-mini, StepLearn reaches 59.9% average success on WebArena-Lite versus 55.6% for EvoTest, and 84.0% on ALFWorld versus 71.3% for EvoTest. With a locally deployed Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on ALFWorld, StepLearn reaches 88.1% versus 83.9% for EvoTest. Across four settings, gains over EvoTest range from 2.2 to 12.7 percentage points. Ablations support the roles of stepwise acquisition, immediate reuse within the current episode, and memory retention. Auxiliary learner calls are a small fraction of cost: 5.5% and 3.7% of total API cost on the two benchmarks.","reading_guide":"A 30 to 40 minute skim is appropriate. \\hat{a}_t。作者在概念上写成 P(\\hat{a}_t | s_t, s_{t+1})，并不是单独训练一个经典 inverse dynamics model 再外挂到 policy 上，而是把这种能力内化到统一 policy network 中，用于 RL 优化。\n\n在此基础上，论文提出 Self-Consistency Reward, SCR。直观上，如果 policy 选择的动作 Second, a meta-meta-harness binds full black-box coding-agent products, such as Claude Code, Codex, and OpenHands, through adapter contracts. Muon-style matrix optimization, especially through its interaction with approximate polar computation and EMA momentum? The answer developed in the full paper is no in the worst case. Under operator-norm geometry, row normalization introduces a dimension-dependent penalty proportional to the number of rows m, because it improves row balance at the cost of degrading alignment between the update direction and the true gradient. The paper’s main point is that this penalty is intrinsic to row normalization itself, not an artifact of approximate polar computation or a particular momentum setting.","importance":"This matters for pretraining research because Muon and NorMuon are no longer toy optimizer proposals; they are being discussed and adopted in real LLM training stacks. That distinction is important. It means the practical gains of NorMuon should be attributed to properties of real training dynamics—such as neuron-wise imbalance, heterogeneous row leverage, gradient noise structure, or deep-network optimization geometry—rather than to a universally stronger convergence rate. improve uniformly. The central issue is task structure. A team behaves differently when success depends on one member finding the right discrete answer than when success depends on averaging continuous estimates. Voting, pass@N, revision, and averaging have different statistical limits, so a single team-size scaling story is misleading.","importance":"The contribution is not a pretraining method, but it is useful for researchers working on test-time compute and model-output distributions. If item-level bias dominates, averaging does little. These observations matter for designing self-consistency, debate data, verifiers, and evaluations of whether models provide genuinely diverse hypotheses.","technical_approach":"The authors use Steiner’s taxonomy of group tasks as the organizing frame. They focus on disjunctive tasks, such as QA and math problems where the team may succeed if one member is correct or if voting/verifier selection picks the right answer, and compensatory tasks, such as Fermi estimates where the team output is an average. They model independently sampled agents as conditionally independent given the item. Under this model, plurality voting converges to the model’s item-level modal answer, while averaging converges to the model’s item-level bias. This separates two mechanisms that are often conflated: the probability that the correct answer appears somewhere in the sample set, and the probability that aggregation selects it.","experiments":"The study evaluates 13 open-weight models with teams of up to 30 agents. On disjunctive tasks, pass@N increases with team size, with gains of roughly 5–20 percentage points. Plurality voting, however, is tightly bounded by the modal-answer limit; the conditional-independence model predicts large-team voting accuracy within about 0.5 points. Revision rounds improve accuracy, but using one peer gives nearly the same improvement as using 29 peers, suggesting that most of the benefit comes from a single perturbation rather than from scaling the team. On compensatory Fermi-estimation tasks, item-level bias explains about 87% of squared log-error, and averaging reduces error by only about 6%. Heterogeneous teams improve over their average member, but on disjunctive tasks they do not exceed the strongest member; for Fermi estimates, a five-model team of 7B–8B models can outperform its individual members.","reading_guide":"A skim is sufficient, about 25–35 minutes. It isolates static binding recall rather than claiming to measure world-state tracking or multi-step state updates.","importance":"The useful contribution for pretraining research is a concrete capacity metric for in-context working memory, together with a careful separation between scale, recipe, interference, and task-specific learnability. On continuous recall curves for 12 models at or below 3B parameters, the measured half-recall load follows K50 = c N^0.820 with R² = 0.73. This is not a language-model-loss scaling law; it is an empirical law for zero-shot binding capacity. The broader sweep over 30 open models up to 12B shows large recipe-associated variation: for example, the Pythia ladder stays around k* = 3 to 6 from 410M to 12B, while Qwen2.5-3B reaches the measurement ceiling. The paper is appropriately cautious: in the continuous-curve subset, no clear recipe effect is detected after controlling for scale, partly because the number of modern models is limited.","technical_approach":"The task presents bindings of the form “entity: obligation”, where entities and one-token obligations are sampled from disjoint pools. After D distractor tokens, the model is queried with the entity and is counted correct if the correct obligation has the highest logit. Chance accuracy is 1 over the obligation pool, reported as 0.040. The discrete statistic k* is the smallest K where recall falls below the midpoint between the model’s own K=1 ceiling and chance. Because such thresholds can create artificial discontinuities, the paper also fits smooth recall-versus-log-K curves and reports K50, the continuous half-retention point. A separate interference analysis shows that distractors can reduce the single-binding ceiling without changing the load-dependent profile, which matters when comparing normalized curves across models.","experiments":"The threshold sweep covers 30 open models from ten families, ranging from GPT-2, OPT, BLOOM, Pythia, and Cerebras models to OLMo, Qwen2.5, Mistral, OLMoE, and DeepSeek-Coder variants. 通常把数据量拆成图像数、文本数或各域比例，然后用经验项拟合模态交互。但这会混淆两个因素：每个模态看到了多少样本，以及这些样本是否成对出现。论文把 pairing fraction p = 2 n_p / (D_1 + D_2) 单独拿出来，在固定每个模态数据预算的条件下做 sweep。结论很重要：unpaired data 可以降低单模态信息和冗余信息对应的 才能提供的信息；synergistic information S 是单看任一模态都不够、必须同时看两个模态才出现的信息。基于这个分解，论文提出四通道 scaling law：总 data loss 由 R、U_1、U_2、S 四个独立 power-law 曲线相加。不同通道只接收相关数据流：R 可以由任一模态数据降低，U_1 由模态 1 数据降低，U_2 由模态 2 数据降低，S 只由 paired count n_p 降低。这个形式和传统 L(N, D_1, D_2) 的区别在于，它显式建模配对数，而不是只看每个模态的数据量。实验设计也围绕这个隔离变量展开：固定总数据预算 D_1、D_2，改变 n_p 和 pairing fraction p；未配对样本用可学习 null vector 和 modality-presence bit 填补缺失模态；测试时两个模态始终存在；损失用 的和；当 p 接近 1 时，unique rows 反而减少。训练步数固定，因此 p=1 时 epoch 数更高，但梯度步数相同。这个计数方式对 unpaired data 更有利，所以若 p 从 0 到 1 仍有收益，主要来自配对本身。关键发现有三点：第一，pairing ratio 对 loss 有强影响，已有不含 p 的多模态 scaling law 无法拟合这些曲线；第二，只有 那样从一开始平滑下降。论文声称四通道 scaling law 在三个环境中比现有形式拟合更好；摘要和正文片段未给出具体拟合误差数值，因此这里不补数字。","reading_guide":"建议精读。先看 Introduction 中对 pairing fraction p 的定义，以及为什么固定 D_1、D_2 后改变 n_p 能隔离出配对效应。然后看四通道 scaling law budget for each modality is held fixed. The central claim is that pairing is not a bookkeeping detail. It controls whether a model can learn synergistic information that only exists when both modalities are observed together.","importance":"This is directly relevant to multimodal pretraining data design. Existing scaling laws usually model loss as a function of per-modality data counts, such as image count and text count, sometimes with empirical interaction terms. That conflates two quantities: how much data each modality receives, and whether those data points are aligned at the sample level. By introducing the pairing fraction p = 2 n_p / (D_1 + D_2) and varying it while holding modality budgets fixed, the paper shows that paired and unpaired data should not be treated as interchangeable. Unpaired data can reduce unimodal or redundant loss, but it cannot reduce synergistic loss. Synergy also appears gated: the loss may remain near chance until enough paired examples are available, rather than following an immediate smooth power-law decay. For VLMs, audio-text models, and video-language pretraining, this changes how one should reason about collecting more unpaired data versus collecting fewer but better paired examples.","technical_approach":"$1b9","experiments":"$1ba","reading_guide":"This one deserves a careful read. The authors call it the Deliberation Drift Cliff: models trained with shallow recurrent deliberation, such as K≤4, can gain at short horizons but collapse when the number of latent reasoning steps is extrapolated to K≥16.","importance":"Its relevance to pretraining is indirect but meaningful. It treats latent reasoning as an alternative to verbose token-level chain-of-thought, and shows that additional inference-time computation is not automatically useful when the computation happens in hidden-state space. The key lesson is that recurrent latent reasoning needs long-horizon dynamical constraints; otherwise the hidden trajectory can move off the training manifold. This matters for Coconut-style latent reasoning, recurrent-depth Transformers, implicit models, and Neural ODE-like reasoning modules.","technical_approach":"The method, Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation, replaces an unconstrained recurrent update with a structured geometric dynamical system. It constrains representations to a unit sphere to prevent norm explosion and representation collapse. It uses contact / port-Hamiltonian dynamics to combine non-conservative rotational flow, which helps traverse combinatorial logic states, with dissipative flow, which stabilizes trajectories. It introduces Direct-Gradient Pure-Tensor Helmholtz-Hodge Decomposition to split the tangent vector field into attracting and circulatory components while enforcing near-exact orthogonality. The authors argue that directly parameterizing the potential component in tangent space avoids the expressivity restriction of scalar-potential gradients and symmetric Hessians. An adaptive RK45 solver with spherical retractions is used to control numerical drift.","experiments":"From the provided full-text excerpt, unconstrained latent deliberation improves at short horizons but drops by 22% to 62% when extrapolated to K=16–32 on standard logical reasoning benchmarks. The paper claims an accuracy increase from 32.73% to 58.67% for the constrained decomposition, while bounding out-of-distribution drift. The RK45 solver with spherical retraction keeps norm drift below 10^-6 over 16 steps. A fixed camera exposes 12 of 24 stickers at each settled state. Since every future cube state is determined exactly by the initial solved state and the action sequence, generated frames can be evaluated against ground-truth states. The model pipeline uses a frozen Wan2.1 VAE for video latents and a frozen ModernBERT encoder for the action prompt, with dedicated action tokens added to the tokenizer. A DiT is trained from scratch with rectified flow matching to predict latent velocities. Additional data at fixed model size gives limited returns: for a 120M AR model, increasing training data from 5M to 8M videos raises average frame accuracy only from 48.11% to 49.33%. Its main question is how to predict the point where additional paths stop providing useful accuracy gains, using observable output statistics rather than a per-instance verifier.","importance":"The work is more relevant to inference-time scaling than to base-model pretraining. Its useful contribution is a clean diagnostic for the effective number of independent votes under correlated reasoning paths. For LLM researchers, the main lesson is that sampling budget is capped by correlation among path correctness events. If the same model and prompt produce correlated errors, increasing K gives far fewer effective samples than the nominal path count suggests.","technical_approach":"The paper frames multi-path reasoning as a diversity-combining problem. Each sampled reasoning path is treated as a noisy branch observation, and answer aggregation is treated as receiver-side combining. The key statistic is the pairwise correctness correlation c. Under an exchangeable model, the vote-level effective sample size is K_eff = K / (1 + (K - 1)c), with an asymptotic ceiling of 1/c. This directly explains why majority voting does not keep improving as in the independent Condorcet setting. The paper also uses GLS analysis for latent embedding aggregation and shows that, under equicorrelation, the optimal symmetric linear combiner is uniform. This supports majority vote as the default for standard self-consistency, while leaving room for weighting or pruning when prompt-template branches have heterogeneous quality. The reduction is task-dependent: QA shows a much larger decrease, about 67%, while code is around 22% and math is roughly 9%–29%. The QA–math gap is statistically significant.
